basic_info.description_header: Hi, I'm Natsuki Mine — a software developer with over three years of professional experience.
basic_info.description: I'm currently pursuing a bachelor degree in Information Technology at OAMK. I have been involved in some projects developing applications both independently and as part of teams. I'm passionate about delivering reliable, user-focused software and enjoy learning new technologies!

projects.title: Internal Web Application for Employee Training Management
projects.description: Developed an internal web app with Laravel and MariaDB to manage employee training records, handling DB design, UI, and full-stack implementation.
projects.overview: Developed an internal web application to manage employee training records for Sanmina. The project's purpose was to renew an old system to a new one. The system allows users to manage employees and training courses. The project was implemented solo, including database design, UI design, and full-stack development using Laravel and MariaDB.

myRoles.content: Designed DB structure using ER model

projects.title: iPad POS Register App Development & Maintenance
projects.description: Developed and maintained an iPad POS app with Laravel backend, handling feature updates, bug fixes, and database changes.
projects.overview: Developed and maintained an iPad POS register application for retail use. Worked in a 3-member team, responsible for implementing new features, updating business logic, and handling database modifications in response to feature requests. Acted as the main support contact for clients, performed bug investigation and fixes, and ensured compatibility with iOS 15/16 and updated Xcode environments.

myRoles.content: Added tables and modified SQL for new functionality
Developed iPad app features in response to requirements
Implemented Web API features using Laravel
Investigated and fixed customer-reported bugs / Updated Xcode and ensured iOS 15/16 compatibility
Acted as main point of contact in maintenance meetings

projects.title: Movie Discovery & Review Web App
projects.description: Developed a movie search and review web app in a 7-member university project using React, Express, and PostgreSQL.
projects.overview: As part of a 7-member university course project, built a full-stack web application for discovering movies, posting reviews, and creating groups of users and favorite films. The frontend was developed in React.js and the backend in Express with PostgreSQL. I implemented the movie detail display page, created signup/login/logout/account deletion/favorite APIs, wrote automated tests for the REST API, and deployed the frontend, backend, and database to Azure.

myRoles.content: Built movie detail display page in React.js
Implemented signup, login, logout, account delete, favorites APIs / Created REST API automated tests
Deployed frontend, backend, and DB to Azure

projects.title: Multilingual Grammar Correction Web Service
projects.description: Contributing remotely as an intern to a 10-member team developing a multilingual grammar correction service, creating and optimizing Python scripts for training datasets.
projects.overview: Participating remotely as an intern in a 10-member team developing a multilingual grammar correction web service similar to Grammarly. Responsible for creating Python scripts to generate large-scale datasets for training AI models that correct grammatical errors. Optimized these scripts to improve performance and reduce execution time for massive data processing, focusing on English and Arabic dataset generation.

myRoles.content: Created Python scripts to generate training data / Optimized scripts for large-scale data processing
